When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide, over 14' high, over 53' long

Special Information Needed

  • Serial # of truck

Times Of Movement

  • 1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset.
  • Loads not exceeding 10' wide,16'6" high, may travel on interstate highways continuously.
  • Overweight only may operate 24 hrs/ day, 7 days/ week

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • On state highways:
  • width over 20'- 1 (front if 2-lane, rear if multi-lane)
  • On interstate:
  • width over 16'- 1 rear. In Black Hills area see permit.
  • Mobile Home: escorts are at the discretion of the permit authority
  • Black Hills area:
  • Width exceeds 10’-1 front escort required

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • General: Licensed motor vehicles--no motorcycles
  • Signs: “WIDE LOAD AHEAD” (mounted on front of leading escort) or “WIDE LONG LOAD” (mounted on back of trailing escort) in letters 12” high
  • Lights: Revolving (or 2 2-way flashing) amber lights at least 4” in diameter
  • Flags: Bright red or orange flags; 12” square min.; mounted on brackets or standards on each side of the signs.
  • Additional equipment: None specified

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • None specified
